notes: The freezer history now lives on this server in a plain SQL database the hub owns - Home Assistant keeps none of it. It holds two years instead of the one rolling year InfluxDB kept, and it backs up to Google Drive nightly with everything else. Whether each freezer is in or out of service is now recorded too, so months later a chart shows a hatched band saying it was unplugged rather than a warm stretch that looks like a failure. Each freezer also gets its own panel and its own scale, because a standup sitting at room temperature used to flatten the three working chests into an unreadable strip.
